method: felt-subset bias of catalog-truth GMPE predictions vs windowed kmoni period-max; additive intensity correction, clamped [-1.5,0.5], min 2 events per bin

zhao2006.note: Additive distance-binned intensity correction for zhao2006-routed forecasts, re-fitted 2026-08-17 against the FAITHFUL Zhao et al. (2006) implementation (paper Tables 4/5/6, natural-log form, native Vs30 site classes) from frozen K-NET/KiK-net station residuals (tohoku2011, tokachi2003, fukushima2022, hyuganada2024; 1925 stations) with JMA-catalog prediction hypocenters by tools/scorecard-strong-motion.js --fit-model-bias=zhao2006. The faithful model is unbiased inside 100 km (measured -0.01..-0.03 intensity); the >100 km bins correct the point-source hypocentral-distance convention against mega-ruptures (true Rrup scoring in tools/probe-zhao2006-faithful.js: overall PGA bias +0.11). deltaI = -(measured per-bin bias), hard-capped at +/-1.0; applies only at M>=7 (fitted range M7.1-9.1) and inside the measured hypocentral-distance bins; bins outside the measured range are no-ops. Si-midorikawa-routed crustal events and explicitly user-selected kanno2006 forecasts carry their own modelBias blocks below. R0-4/R1 caveat (2026-08-24): leave-one-event-out on the 4-event routing set shows this correction does NOT generalize to unseen events (held-out intensity RMS 0.931 vs uncorrected 0.899, tools/data/model-bias-loeo-report.json) — treat it as an empirical alignment for these four events until more interplate/intraslab events are frozen (fukushima2021 is reserved for the JMA independent blind split and stays out). See tools/data/strong-motion-report.json.

si-midorikawa.note: Additive distance-binned intensity correction for si-midorikawa-routed forecasts, re-fitted 2026-08-24 from frozen K-NET/KiK-net station residuals (nine crustal events: kumamoto2016, noto2024, chuetsu2004, iwate2008, fukuoka2005, noto2007, fukushima2011, yamagata2019, iburihigashi2018; 2962 stations) with JMA-catalog prediction hypocenters by tools/scorecard-strong-motion.js --fit-model-bias=si-midorikawa. R1 expansion replaced the 2-event fit (R0-4 LOEO had shown it did not generalize: held-out RMS 0.631->0.780); on the 9-event set leave-one-event-out passes (held-out 0.635 vs uncorrected 0.637, tools/data/model-bias-loeo-report.json). deltaI = -(measured per-bin bias), hard-capped at +/-1.0; applies only at M>=7 and inside the measured hypocentral-distance bins; bins outside the measured range are no-ops. See tools/data/strong-motion-report.json.

kanno2006.note: Additive distance-binned intensity correction for explicitly user-selected kanno2006 forecasts (auto routing never selects kanno2006), re-fitted 2026-08-24 by forcing the model onto all thirteen frozen events (6-event original set + 7 R1 crustal expansion events; 4887 stations) with JMA-catalog prediction hypocenters by tools/scorecard-strong-motion.js --fit-model-bias=kanno2006 (forced-model fit). Leave-one-event-out passes on the expanded set (held-out intensity RMS 0.772 vs uncorrected 0.807, tools/data/model-bias-loeo-report.json). deltaI = -(measured per-bin bias), hard-capped at +/-1.0; applies only at M>=7 and inside the measured hypocentral-distance bins; bins outside the measured range are no-ops. See tools/data/strong-motion-report.json.
